description: Illustrative review prompts only. Customers should describe their own genuine experience.

templates.text: Mention whether the installation process was explained clearly, how the technician handled the setup, and whether you received helpful instructions before using your battery.
Describe your installation experience, including the time taken, cleanliness of the work, safety precautions followed, and how clearly the team explained operating instructions.
Installation ke experience ke baare mein likhein, technician ne setup kaise kiya, safety explain ki ya nahi, aur battery use karna kitna easy laga.
Apna installation experience share karein, team time par aayi thi ya nahi, fitting properly hui, aur battery chalane ki instructions clearly samjhayi gayi.
Share what you noticed about battery quality, packaging, product condition, performance expectations, and whether the staff helped you understand the specifications before purchasing.
Explain which product features mattered to you, how the available options were compared, and whether the battery quality matched your requirements and budget.
Battery ki quality, product options, specifications aur packaging ke baare mein apna experience batayein, aur purchase se pehle kya information mili.
Aapko battery ke features aur quality kaise lage, staff ne different models compare karwaye ya nahi, aur aapki requirements ke hisaab se kya suggest kiya.
Describe how the staff treated you, whether your questions were answered patiently, how convenient the purchase process felt, and what stood out during your visit.
Share your experience with customer service, communication, product recommendations, billing clarity, and whether the team helped you make an informed purchasing decision.
Staff ka behaviour, product samjhane ka tareeka, billing process aur overall service experience kaisa raha, apne words mein share karein.
Shop par visit ke time staff kitna helpful tha, queries ka response kaisa mila, aur product select karne mein kitni assistance mili.
Describe the assistance you received after purchasing, including maintenance guidance, warranty information, troubleshooting help, and how easily you could contact the staff.
Share whether your questions after purchase were handled properly, what guidance you received about battery care, and how helpful the support team was.
Purchase ke baad support kaisa mila, warranty details samjhayi gayi, maintenance tips diye aur problem hone par contact karna kitna convenient raha.
Battery related queries par team ne kya help ki, troubleshooting samjhayi ya nahi, aur after-sales service ke experience ko apne words mein describe karein.
Summarize your overall experience, mentioning product selection, staff communication, pricing transparency, service quality, and anything that made your visit memorable.
Describe your visit from beginning to end, what you purchased, how the team assisted you, and whether the experience met your expectations.
Rajasthan Battery House par overall experience share karein, product selection, staff behaviour, pricing, service aur visit ke dauran mili assistance ke baare mein.
Aapki shop visit kaisi rahi, battery choose karne mein kitni help mili, staff ka response kaisa tha aur overall experience expectations ke according raha.
